brief: Build an enterprise AI recruiting platform

fields.name: Vision
fields.value: Build an enterprise AI recruiting platform

fields.name: Problem
fields.value: Recruiting workflows are slow, manual, or inconsistent

fields.name: Differentiation
fields.value: Category-specialized expertise graph for ai-product with evidence-backed review gates

fields.name: User Flows
fields.value: 1) Enterprise buyers and operators states intent 2) system composes expertise package 3) Review Council gates acceptance 4) export/handoff for ai product

fields.name: Technical Stack
fields.value: TypeScript/Next.js application layer; model/provider adapter boundary; evaluation harness; PostgreSQL for transactional state

fields.name: Architecture
fields.value: Modular monolith with clear domain boundaries for ai product; stack assumptions: TypeScript/Next.js application layer; model/provider adapter boundary; evaluation harness; PostgreSQL for transactional state

fields.name: Risk Analysis
fields.value: Unresolved DNA assumptions treated as facts; Unsafe agent execution permissions; Hallucinated recommendations without evidence

fields.name: Roadmap
fields.value: Discovery → validated DNA → accepted package → external-agent handoff
